get.description: Creates and schedules a new report.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to report on.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The report title shown in the UI and used in generated filenames.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The delivery schedule for the report.

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: The hour of day in 24-hour format when the report should be sent.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: The transport medium identifier, such as `email`.

parameters.name: reportFormat
parameters.description: The output format identifier, such as `pdf` or `html`.

parameters.description: The transport-specific parameters to store with the report.

get.description: Marks a scheduled report as deleted.

get.description: Returns scheduled reports that match the supplied filters.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Filters reports to a specific website when provided.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Filters reports by delivery schedule when provided.

parameters.name: idReport
parameters.description: Filters to a single scheduled report when provided.

parameters.name: ifSuperUserReturnOnlySuperUserReports
parameters.description: If `true`, super users only receive their own reports.

parameters.name: idSegment
parameters.description: Filters reports to a specific saved segment when provided.

200.description: The matching scheduled reports with decoded `parameters` and `reports` fields.

get.description: Generates a scheduled report in the requested output mode.

parameters.name: idReport
parameters.description: The scheduled report ID to generate.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language code to render the report in, or `false` to use the default language.

parameters.name: outputType
parameters.description: The output mode. Use `OUTPUT_DOWNLOAD`, `OUTPUT_SAVE_ON_DISK`, `OUTPUT_INLINE`, or `OUTPUT_RETURN`.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The data period to generate, or `false` to use the report's stored period.

parameters.name: reportFormat
parameters.description: The output format identifier, such as `pdf` or `html`, or `false` to use the stored format.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Transport-specific parameters to override for this generation, or `false` to use the stored parameters.

200.description: The saved file metadata when writing to disk, the rendered report contents when using `OUTPUT_RETURN`, or no value when streaming the report to the browser.

parameters.name: idReport
parameters.description: The scheduled report ID to send.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The data period to send, or `false` to use the stored period.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date to generate the report for, or `false` to use the previous scheduled period.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Whether to send the report even if it has already been sent for the same period.

tags.name: ScheduledReports
tags.description: The ScheduledReports API lets you manage Scheduled Email reports, as well as generate, download or email any existing report. "generateReport" will generate the requested report (for a specific date range, website and in the requested language). "sendReport" will send the report by email to the recipients specified for this report. You can also get the list of all existing reports via "getReports", create new reports via "addReport", or manage existing reports with "updateReport" and "deleteReport". See also the documentation about Scheduled Email reports in Matomo.
